column1: # Byte ranges certified unreachable that are not census rows (jump slots, and unreached code bytes no walk decodes), `dead` in tools/census_classify.py; keyed by byte range.
# Columns: module, linear address of the first byte, bytes, evidence. Same rule as docs/census-dead.tsv: only when certain.
# A slot is live code in the programs that bind it, so only slots that no program can enter qualify. Certificates and the full per-slot table:
# D:/f117-gate/slots-review-20261021/ (certificates-new.tsv, notes.txt). Scans: every E8/E9/9A/EA transfer with all segment aliases, relocated
# segment/offset word pairs in all 18 modules plus SPEECH.117, ROSTER.FIL and LABSLOGO.SS, each program's single binder (which slots it fills).
